verdict.rationale: Crossplane is reconciliation-based rather than plan/apply-based; it lacks a native 'terraform plan'-style headless diff step against live cloud state — the CLI's `render` (docs-7) can test compositions locally but does not produce an applyable diff, and a direct probe confirms there is no local plan/preview loop and every real change requires a live control-plane cluster (crossplane-probe-2). GitOps-style PR diffs on YAML are possible in principle (crossplane-comm-9/10) but this is an indirect, DIY workaround, not a documented agent-plan-diff-approve capability.
